edge.scope: Isolated real browser extension and real native desktop; localhost and cookie permission pre-granted in the isolated fixture manifest

results.name: Real msedge extension reaches isolated native UDM
Per-tab disable hides video controls across refresh and rejects handoff; enable restores them
Real link-selection window sends two Download later jobs through the persistent native host
Observed Authorization and Origin reach native byte-range downloads and remain encrypted in saved history
Browser reuses one native host for settings, multiple downloads and acknowledgements
Trusted video-panel click downloads a byte-identical MP4 through real native messaging
Observed recorded HLS downloads and assembles playable 360p video with audio
Automatic msedge file capture hands off to native UDM and cancels the browser transfer
Trusted Ctrl+Insert click bypasses both file-type filters and completes the native download
Trusted Alt-click keeps a normally captured file in the browser without creating a UDM job
Holding Ctrl+Insert captures a delayed script download without any link click
Trusted force gesture cannot enable automatic capture when the browser opt-in is off
Real iframe navigation retains the frame ID but excludes previous-document playlists
No page-script errors during real extension capture

limitations: Isolated Edge tests use local fixtures and pre-granted localhost/cookie permissions
Live elevated driver test still pending existing Windows consent
Production upgrade and uninstall lifecycle not qualified by this build
New desktop process attachment and HTTPS original-response takeover remain open
Full IDM parity is not established
